name: Those Nights at Fredbear's
storyline:
Those Nights at Fredbear's is a faithful recreation of the original TNaF made by Nikson. This version has been made to give people an almost perfectly accurate recreation of the original cancelled version but also build on that with a fully rewritten and lengthy story mode.

This game currently has a demo for the 6am mode, with this mode being a full remake of the original cancelled July 2015 build of TNaF, with 5 nights plus extra content. The demo sets out to be visually accurate to said cancelled build, while building on that to provide a complete experience.

The completed game will be separated into two modes; the "6am Mode" and the "Story Mode".
summary: A faithful remake and completion of Nikson's original Those Nights at Fredbear's game.
